explication: ParlAI is a research framework for training and evaluating dialogue and multimodal agents against a shared catalog of tasks, as well as connecting agents to human participants. A typical workflow configures a run, loads a task and agent, exchanges observations and actions in a world, and evaluates model output. Core abstractions support that workflow; separate subsystems provide retrieval, pretrained models, crowdsourcing, and live chat. The relationships shown are limited to README statements and SOURCE INDEX references; unsampled components are represented at their existing directory paths.
